vo_open.text: This man hiccuped for sixty-eight years.

vo.text: In 1922, Charles Osborne was preparing to slaughter a hog. It collapsed on top of him.
vo.cap: *1922:* a *350-pound hog* collapsed on top of him.

vo.text: He started hiccuping. And he didn't stop.
An estimated four hundred and thirty million hiccups. A Guinness world record.
vo.cap: An estimated *430 million hiccups.* A world record.
